title: Load revision helper metadata
responsibility: Loads committed examples, helper signatures and their distinct consumers from the selected revision.

inputs.name: unitMetadata.tree
inputs.description: Reads files from the exact Git revision being viewed.

inputs.name: unitMetadata.units
inputs.description: Registered entities to enrich with their documentation and exported shared helpers.

outputs.name: unitMetadata
outputs.description: Updates each entity in place. Missing source leaves an explicit gap; another revision is never substituted.
